# ============================================================
# BIOS6624 Project 2 - Script 02: Power Analysis
#
# Purpose:
#   - Define Aim 1 and Aim 2 power assumptions
#   - Estimate power for Aim 1 models
#   - Estimate power for Aim 2 interaction models
#
# Outputs:
#   Results/Tables/aim1_memory_power.csv
#   Results/Tables/aim1_cortical_power.csv
#   Results/Tables/aim2_interaction_power.csv
# ============================================================

```{r cars}
# -----------------------
# Clean environment
# -----------------------
rm(list = ls())

# -----------------------
# Load libraries
# -----------------------
library(powertools)
library(tidyverse)

# -----------------------
# Define directories
# -----------------------
results_tbl <- "C:/Users/mojde/Desktop/Documents/BIOS-6624-Projects/Project2/Results/Tables"
results_fig <- "C:/Users/mojde/Desktop/Documents/BIOS-6624-Projects/Project2/Results/Figures"
output_dir  <- "C:/Users/mojde/Desktop/Documents/BIOS-6624-Projects/Project2/Output"

# Create folders if they don't exist
dir.create(results_tbl, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(results_fig, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```



```{r cars}
# -----------------------
# Global alpha
# -----------------------
alpha <- 0.05

# ============================================================
# Aim 1: Main-effect omnibus tests
# ============================================================

# Sample size and model settings
N_aim1 <- 175
p_aim1 <- 14

# If the omnibus test is for 4 primary inflammatory markers jointly:
q_aim1 <- 4

# -----------------------
# Aim 1 power: memory
# Conservative partial correlations based on preliminary correlations
# between markers and CVLT change
# -----------------------
aim1_memory_power <- data.frame(
  scenario = c("Conservative", "Moderate", "Optimistic"),
  pc = c(0.15, 0.20, 0.25)
)

aim1_memory_power$power <- c(
  mlrF.partial(N = N_aim1, p = p_aim1, q = q_aim1, pc = 0.15, alpha = alpha),
  mlrF.partial(N = N_aim1, p = p_aim1, q = q_aim1, pc = 0.20, alpha = alpha),
  mlrF.partial(N = N_aim1, p = p_aim1, q = q_aim1, pc = 0.25, alpha = alpha)
)

# -----------------------
# Aim 1 power: cortical thickness
# Stronger preliminary correlations, but using conservative partial
# correlation assumptions after covariate adjustment
# -----------------------
aim1_cortical_power <- data.frame(
  scenario = c("Conservative", "Moderate", "Optimistic"),
  pc = c(0.30, 0.40, 0.50)
)

aim1_cortical_power$power <- c(
  mlrF.partial(N = N_aim1, p = p_aim1, q = q_aim1, pc = 0.30, alpha = alpha),
  mlrF.partial(N = N_aim1, p = p_aim1, q = q_aim1, pc = 0.40, alpha = alpha),
  mlrF.partial(N = N_aim1, p = p_aim1, q = q_aim1, pc = 0.50, alpha = alpha)
)

print(aim1_memory_power)
print(aim1_cortical_power)

```


```{r cars}
# ============================================================
# Aim 2: Interaction omnibus tests
# ============================================================

N_aim2 <- 175
p_aim2 <- 19

# If the omnibus interaction test is for 4 interaction terms jointly:
q_aim2 <- 4

aim2_interaction_power <- data.frame(
  scenario = c("Small", "Moderate", "Large"),
  pc = c(0.10, 0.15, 0.20)
)

aim2_interaction_power$power <- c(
  mlrF.partial(N = N_aim2, p = p_aim2, q = q_aim2, pc = 0.10, alpha = alpha),
  mlrF.partial(N = N_aim2, p = p_aim2, q = q_aim2, pc = 0.15, alpha = alpha),
  mlrF.partial(N = N_aim2, p = p_aim2, q = q_aim2, pc = 0.20, alpha = alpha)
)

print(aim2_interaction_power)

```



```{r cars}
# ============================================================
# Save tables
# ============================================================

write.csv(
  aim1_memory_power,
  file.path(results_tbl, "aim1_memory_power.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  aim1_cortical_power,
  file.path(results_tbl, "aim1_cortical_power.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  aim2_interaction_power,
  file.path(results_tbl, "aim2_interaction_power.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```
